title: Dynamic Token Reweighting for Robust Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense mechanism (Dynamic Token Reweighting) to improve the robustness of Vision-Language Models against multimodal jailbreak attacks. While jailbreak defense is a component of AI safety and involves refusing 'harmful' (unethical) prompts, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral frameworks.
